place.name: Lillaz Falls
place.description: The Lillaz Falls (French pronunciation: [lila]; Italian: Cascate di Lillaz; French: Cascades de Lillaz) is a waterfall along the Urtier river near Cogne in the Aosta Valley, Italy. The waterfalls, located within the territory of the Gran Paradiso National Park, consist of three main drops with a total height of approximately 150 m (490 ft).
